out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. OBSERVED 2025 PERMIT POSTED RATHER THAN THE 2026 PERMIT.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PLACE THE ACTIVE PERMIT IN A CONSPICUOUS LOCATION BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL COCKROACH KILLER ACROSS FROM THE THREE-DOOR STANDING COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: PESTICIDE DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED TONGS WITH HANDLE DIRECTLY IN FOOD IN THE FOOD SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: FOOD EMPLOYEES PROPERLY PLACED TONGS DURING INSPECTION. SIMPLY SOCIAL (Inspection Date: 10/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no handwashing soap at the handsink on the wall adjacent to the three-door standing cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: Handsoap provided to the sink during inspection. Employees re-educated. Please ensure both handwashing sinks are always supplied with soap to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Copy provided to PIC, PIC posted Vomit and DIarrhea

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the red sanitizing bucket on the front counter with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. Person in charge remade sanitizer bucket so the concentration met at least 50 ppm

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: EHS observed the handwashing sink the back of the kitchen next to the dishpit did not have soap available during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC refilled the dispenser with hand soap.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Bleach and water solution was measured at 200+ ppm in a sanitizer bucket next to the. 2 door prep top cooler. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: PIC disposed of the sanitizer solution, remade sanitizer solution and verified concentration to be 100ppm using an appropriate test kit.

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility “RAID”
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of RAID. Reviewed with EHS about not possessing residential use pesticides in facility.
